description: Return the latest per-country physical dealer/retail gold prices — real quotes from dealers, mints, and bullion benchmarks, NOT spot-derived arithmetic — with nullable premium_over_spot_bps per quote (null when live reference inputs are unavailable). `country` is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. ID, MY, AE, JP). Uncovered countries return unknown_country on every plan. Requires the Physical tier or higher; static sample responses for evaluation are in the docs at https://goldprice.dev/docs/physical.
name: get_physical_price
title: Get Physical Dealer Gold Prices
